nodes.title: Fog over Saltmarsh
nodes.description: Smugglers have choked the harbor and Harbor Master Oswin begs for help reopening the tide lock.

nodes.title: Duel the Smuggler Captain
nodes.description: You challenge the smuggler captain on the docks and send his crew fleeing.

nodes.title: Negotiate with the Smugglers
nodes.description: You broker a truce: the smugglers stand down in exchange for safe passage.

nodes.title: Ignore the Harbor Plea
nodes.description: You shrug off Oswin's plea and head to the harbor office on your own business.

nodes.title: The Harbor Master's Map
nodes.description: Whatever your choice on the docks, Oswin hands you his chart of the sunken channels.

nodes.title: Recruit Mira the Navigator
nodes.description: Mira, a disgraced navigator, offers to guide you through the channels.

nodes.title: The Drowned Rat Tavern
nodes.description: The tavern is the town's beating heart. Both the Fishers' Guild and the Merchant Cartel want your allegiance.

nodes.title: Rumors at the Bar
nodes.description: A round of drinks loosens tongues about the leviathan beneath the lock.

nodes.title: Side with the Fishers' Guild
nodes.description: The fishers lend you their boats and crews.

nodes.title: Side with the Merchant Cartel
nodes.description: The cartel pays well and asks few questions. The fishers curse your name.

nodes.title: Open the Tide Lock
nodes.description: Following Oswin's chart, you reach the rusted tide lock and force it open.

nodes.title: Calm the Leviathan
nodes.description: The leviathan rises through the open lock. You sing the old shanty and it sinks back to sleep.

nodes.title: Slay the Leviathan
nodes.description: The leviathan rises through the open lock and you drive a harpoon through its eye.

nodes.title: Dawn over the Marsh
nodes.description: Ships sail again. Oswin thanks you on the pier as the fog finally lifts.
nodes.narrative_requirements: Oswin the Harbor Master is alive and the tide lock has been reopened.
